name: Estavel Hall 34 Original
description: This listing is a flaw-lead sighting deck listed with deck area 826 square metres, freeboard 24 centimetres, occupancy 27 people. Its remaining stated figures are mooring depth 60 metres, per person set after acceptance, station keeping fixed mooring. Every one of them is quoted from the same six axes the other listings in this category are described on.
